description: This source file is a PHP class for handling order-related email notifications within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages sending emails when orders are added, updated, or flagged, including order details, status updates, and alerts.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A controller class for managing order-related email notifications in Opencart, including sending order confirmation, status updates, and alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles order status change events, decides whether to add or update order emails based on the order info.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email notification for new order addition with detailed order info and download links if applicable.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email notification when the order history is updated, including status and comments.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to configured recipients when an order status changes, with detailed order info.
